Good afternoon kennel team,
This week, the welfare officer noted a reminder about noise levels

Please keep voices low near the holding area and maintain a calm pace during handover. The Companion Animal Travel Desk appreciates the care already shown by the cabin team, and steady routines continue to help each pet settle well. <<FACT F040>> Please record any concerns in the file at once so that the records remain clear and reassuring for the travelers.

For cases moving through Brightwater, please confirm the pet deck details before departure and share any update with the desk promptly. <<FACT F044>> If a pet appears unsettled, use the usual comfort measures and advise the senior coordinator without delay. Clear notes support safe care from booking through pickup, and they also help us respond with confidence and consistency.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
